units.summary: Jamie arrives at an old boarding house in Seoul and meets everyone.

lessons.goal: Say hello, say your name and where you're from.
Ask "what is this?" and point to things near and far.
Say what is (and isn't) in a room, and where things are.
Say where places are: next to, in front of, behind, over there.
Say thank you, sorry, it's okay, and goodbye.

units.summary: Family, jobs, countries and numbers: getting to know everyone.

lessons.goal: Talk about your family and say "my" and "our".
Name brothers and sisters the Korean way.
Talk about jobs and schools.
Name countries and languages, and use "and / with".
Count with Sino-Korean numbers: phone numbers and room numbers.
Introduce yourself and your family in a few sentences.

units.summary: Breakfast with Grandma, tastes, midnight ramen and Korean food.

lessons.goal: Say what you eat and drink using present-tense verbs.
Describe tastes and say what you like and don't like.
Say what you want to do.
Understand polite requests at the table.
Ask for things with 주세요.
Order food and talk about snacks and drinks.

units.summary: Seo-yeon shows Jamie around: shops, places, directions and the Han River.

lessons.goal: Say where you're going.
Say where you do things with 에서.
Say why you're going somewhere.
Ask for and follow directions.
Link sentences with "and" and describe nature.

units.summary: Time, daily routines, Korean class, the days of the week, and a mysterious sketchbook.

lessons.goal: Tell the time with native Korean numbers.
Describe your morning routine with times.
Talk about your class and studies.
Talk about what you did, with the past tense.
Talk about days, today, tomorrow and the weekend.
Retell what happened today.

units.summary: Shopping with Min-jun: counting, prices, ages and asking for things.

lessons.goal: Name everyday things in a shop.
Count things with native numbers and counters.
Ask prices and pay.
Ask people to do things for you.
Ask and say ages, and use 만 ("only").
Use little words like "oh", "yeah" and "um" naturally.

units.summary: Jamie gets a part-time job at Mr. Park's café — and the sketchbook comes true.

lessons.goal: Say what you can and can't do.
Say what you have to do.
Understand rules: "don't" and "please wait".
Say what you can't do with 못.
Make phone calls and ask permission.

units.summary: Making plans, the weather, a rained-out picnic, seasons and travel dreams.

lessons.goal: Talk about plans with "will / going to".
Make suggestions and talk about the weather.
React to what you see with -네요.
Contrast two ideas with "but".
Suggest doing things together.
Talk about this year, last year and next year.

units.summary: A trip to Gyeongbokgung Palace with Grandma and Ji-woo.

lessons.goal: Say how you get around.
Link actions: get off and transfer.
Ask how long things take and when.
Say "if": conditions and choices.
Say you're going back, coming back, and why.

units.summary: Jamie catches a cold: body parts, symptoms, the pharmacy, feelings, and Grandma's porridge.

lessons.goal: Name parts of the body; say what someone is doing right now.
Explain why with -아서/-어서.
Give reasons with -(으)니까, and say how often.
Handle verbs that change shape (irregulars).
Give reasons with 때문에, 왜냐하면 and 그러니까; ask "right?" with -죠.

units.summary: Hobbies, sports, karaoke night, Seo-yeon's dream — and a mysterious man asking about Byeol.

lessons.goal: Talk about things you like doing.
Compare things: "more than" and "the most".
Say what you have (or haven't) done before.
Say "before" and "after" doing something.
Tell a short story about your week.

units.summary: Hot days, shopping for clothes, colors — and the man in the suit returns.

lessons.goal: Say "when" something happens.
Try things on with -아/어 보세요.
Describe things with adjectives before nouns.
Describe people by what they are doing or wearing.

units.summary: Dates, party plans, honorific Korean, and a surprise guest.

lessons.goal: Say dates: months, days and years.
Promise to do things with -(으)ㄹ게요.
Use honorific verbs for elders.
Give things to elders politely.
Tell the main events of a life.

units.summary: Lost things, a house meeting, formal Korean on the news, a quarrel — and the sketchbook's last page.

lessons.goal: Describe things with past actions: "the key I lost".
Give background before your main point with -는데.
Understand formal speech: -ㅂ니다 / -습니다.
Guess and intend with -겠-.
Connect a whole story with 그래서, 그런데, 그러니까.

units.summary: The housemates switch to casual speech — and the key opens Grandma's old drawer.

lessons.goal: Speak casually (반말) with friends.
Make casual suggestions with -자.
Ask questions casually.
Say what you believe, and whether something's true.
Switch between casual speech and humble honorifics.

units.summary: A big cleaning day: rooms, chores, broken plates, recycling — and old photos in the storeroom.

lessons.goal: Name the rooms of a house; do things in advance with -아/어 놓다.
Say something happened completely (and maybe badly) with -아/어 버리다.
Describe states with -아/어 있다.
Talk about rules and habits.
Fix, set up and settle in for the night.

units.summary: Market shopping, cooking steps, tasting, kimchi-making day, and Min-jun's fusion dishes.

lessons.goal: Do two things at once with -(으)면서.
Give cooking steps with -고 나서.
Say you were doing one thing when something else happened (-다가).
Describe a family food tradition.
Talk about favorite foods and fusion dishes.

units.summary: Colors, clothes and accessories, shopping for a party outfit — and a jealous Min-jun.

lessons.goal: Say how something looks with -아/어 보이다.
Try on clothes, ask the price, and pay.
Say "I think…" or "it seems…" with -(으)ㄴ/는 것 같다.
Guess about the future with -(으)ㄹ 것 같다.
Describe a picture with literary color words.

units.summary: Grandma twists her ankle: injuries, the doctor, caring for someone, cold symptoms, and body parts.

lessons.goal: Give gentle advice with -는 게 좋겠다.
Say "you don't have to" with -지 않아도 되다.
Say how long it's been with -(으)ㄴ 지 되다.
Describe cold symptoms and home remedies.
Name the parts of the body.

units.summary: Study habits, school subjects, university life, a research report, and test day.

lessons.goal: Say what you've decided with -기로 하다.
Say "if you want to…" with -(으)려면.
Talk about school subjects, grades and after-school academies.
Say "so that…" with -도록.
Talk about assignments and remembering.
Say how sure you are: 분명히, 확실히, 틀림없다.

units.summary: Jobs and dreams, Do-yoon's game company, a job interview, office life, and a company event.

lessons.goal: Say how something came about with -게 되다.
Say something has changed with -아/어지다.
Talk about tech and products.
Say what you know how to do with -(으)ㄹ 줄 알다.
Office ranks, schedules and set phrases.
Talk about events, groups and business.

units.summary: Feelings and moods, a jealous misunderstanding, apologies, and a game of compliments.

lessons.goal: Describe your personality with -는 편이다.
Remind someone of something with -잖아.
Explain the background with -거든.
Apologize and show how you feel (-아/어하다).
Compliment people's personalities.

units.summary: Min-jun's three failed attempts to confess: a restaurant, a concert, and a night out — plus wedding talk with Grandma.

lessons.goal: Suggest and ask what someone wants with -(으)ㄹ래.
Say "in case…" or "worried that…" with -(으)ㄹ까 봐.
Say something almost happened with -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다.
Talk about Korean drinking culture.
Talk about love, marriage and breakups.

units.summary: Phones and calls, searching the internet for Byeol, an old news article, neighborhood rumors, and Min-jun on TV.

lessons.goal: Make a guess from what you see or hear with -나 보다.
Tuck a question into a sentence with -는지.
Read and talk about a news article.
Talk about uncertain things with -(으)ㄹ지.
Talk about TV, media and ads.

units.summary: Banking, errands and money, sending a package, a letter from Gangneung, and a secret phone call.

lessons.goal: Make very polite requests with -아/어 주시겠어요?
Talk about money: pocket money, borrowing, costs.
Divide up tasks with -(으)ㄹ 테니까.
Use passive verbs: 열리다, 들리다, 보이다.
Talk about visiting and meeting people.
Say where things are: 맞은편, 건너편.

units.summary: The map of Korea, a travel agency, trains and buses, booking a place to stay, and packing — plus a day as a Seoul tour guide.

lessons.goal: Report what someone said with -다고 하다.
Report a question with -냐고 묻다.
Report suggestions and orders with -자고 / -(으)라고 하다.
Compare places to stay and book ahead.
Pack and plan; a day as a Seoul tour guide.

units.summary: Scenery from the KTX window, weather reports, an animal quiz, the four seasons, and a night by the sea in Gangneung.

lessons.goal: Remember the past with -던.
Pass on what you heard with -대요 / -래요.
Name animals and learn the Korean zodiac.
Talk about the seasons and nature.
Describe the night sky and the beach.

units.summary: A morning at the beach, finding your way downtown, searching the alleys, a café by the sea — and a glimpse of Byeol.

lessons.goal: Say something is worth doing with -(으)ㄹ 만하다.
Get around town and cross the street.
Point to finished past experiences with -았/었던.
Share what you noticed with -더라고요.
Talk about the journey back to the big city.

units.summary: Losing a wallet, reporting it at the police box, a near-miss traffic accident, playground rules, and a happy ending.

lessons.goal: Explain an unexpected cause with -는 바람에.
Say "so" in casual speech with -아/어 가지고.
Say "even if" with -아/어도.
Read signs and talk about rules.
Talk about laws, luck and things working out.

units.summary: Neighborhood gossip about Do-yoon, rumors at school, Grandma's family, the relatives, and a visit to a mountain temple.

lessons.goal: Check what you heard with -다면서요?
React to surprising news with -다니.
Say "at least" with N(이)라도.
Name aunts, uncles, cousins and in-laws.
Talk about taking, bringing and feeding.

units.summary: The harvest holiday at Starlight House: making songpyeon, family coming home, the feast, old days and new, wishing on the full moon.

lessons.goal: Say "in order to" with -기 위해서.
Say "while" with -는 동안.
Say "make or let someone do" with -게 하다.
Compare the past and the present.
Make a wish under the Chuseok moon.
Talk about years: last year, this year, every year.

units.summary: Grandma's childhood by the sea, war and peace, the history of Starlight House, life and society, and an old photograph.

lessons.goal: Describe past habits with -곤 하다.
Talk about history.
Say what used to be true with -았/었었-.
Talk about society, the world and life.
Say "with … still…" using -(으)ㄴ 채로.

units.summary: Climbing Bukhansan with Grandma, catching your breath, the view from the top, trees and plants, sports talk, and Ji-woo's school sports day.

lessons.goal: Say "as soon as" with -자마자.
Explain why you couldn't do something with -느라고.
Say "the more…, the more…" with -(으)ㄹ수록.
Talk about trees and plants.
Talk about sports and games.
Talk about winning, losing and cheering.

units.summary: Formal news Korean, the environment, pros and cons, a class debate, Min-jun's exam result, a changing neighborhood, and an international exchange day.

lessons.goal: Say "according to" with N에 따르면.
Talk about the environment.
Contrast two facts with -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에.
Give clear reasons with -기 때문에.
Read an official letter.
Talk about a neighborhood changing.
Talk about an international exchange event.

units.summary: Min-jun's food-truck dream: saving up, doing the math, buying a truck, creating the menu, prices and trade — and opening day on the Han River.

lessons.goal: Say "so much that…" with -(으)ㄹ 정도로.
Talk about numbers, limits and rough amounts.
Talk about cars, parking and measurements.
Say "instead of" with -는 대신에.
Talk about income, prices and trade.
Compare with N만큼 ("as … as").

units.summary: Seo-yeon's contest entry, a museum visit, an old bookstore, Byeol's pen name, a river festival, and the award ceremony.

lessons.goal: Say "just / only keep doing" with -기만 하다.
Talk about art and architecture.
Talk about books and literature.
Say "even" with N조차 / N마저.
Talk about music, dance and shows.
Say "can't help but" with -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다.

units.summary: Ji-woo's midnight secret, the truth behind the sketchbook, Do-yoon's confession, why the siblings fought, and a plan for the first snow.

lessons.goal: Say "pretend to" with -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.
Say "there's no way that…" with -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다.
Express regret with -았/었더라면.
Talk about wants, complaints and what's right.
Make a plan together.

units.summary: Seo-yeon's job offer, a fight in the hallway, a sleepless night, a disastrous day at the truck, making up, a big decision, Byeol's new webtoon, and waiting for the snow.

lessons.goal: Give advice to someone close with -아/어야지.
Express regret with -(으)ㄹ걸.
Talk about eyes, tears and things flowing.
Talk about food going wrong in the kitchen.
Say "whether… or…" with -든지.
Talk about attitudes and activities.
Say how often and how much.
Use little adverbs of time and manner.

units.summary: The first snow falls, a visitor at the door, a brother and sister reunited, Byeol's gifts — and Min-jun finally confesses.

lessons.goal: Say "I wish…" with -(으)면 좋겠다.
Welcome someone and react with surprise.
Say "I hope that…" with -기를 바라다.
Describe things by size and texture.
Say "while you're at it" with -(으)ㄴ/는 김에.

units.summary: New Year's Eve fireworks, Seollal morning, everyone's plans, Jamie's big decision, and the last page of the sketchbook.

lessons.goal: Say "start to" with -기 시작하다.
Talk about gratitude and sharing.
Say "not only… but also" with -(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라.
Talk about choices and new beginnings.
Look back on the year together.
